call_purpose: You called about your customers not receiving the order confirmation email after buying, and about the default sender name shown on that email.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you switched on the order confirmation email for your product and saved it, then placed a test order and confirmed that the confirmation email arrived in your inbox.

covered.text: We explained that the sender name can be changed under Email settings, Sender name. The email still shows the default sender name, so this is not yet resolved.

customer_next_steps.text: Change the sender name to your brand name under Email settings, Sender name, as you mentioned you will do.
